+

+from collections import OrderedDict
+import threading
+
+
+class FeatureCache:
+    def __init__(self, max_entries=4096):
+        self._max_entries = max_entries
+        self._store = OrderedDict()
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
+
+    def get(self, key):
+        with self._lock:
+            if key not in self._store:
+                return None
+            self._store.move_to_end(key)
+            return self._store[key]
+
+    def put(self, key, value):
+        with self._lock:
+            self._store[key] = value
+            self._store.move_to_end(key)
+            if len(self._store) > self._max_entries:
+                self._store.popitem(last=False)

+import time
+from typing import Any
+
+
+class TTLCache:
+    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds: float = 30.0):
+        self._ttl = ttl_seconds
+        self._items: dict[str, tuple[float, Any]] = {}
+
+    def get(self, key: str) -> Any | None:
+        entry = self._items.get(key)
+        if entry is None:
+            return None
+        expires_at, value = entry
+        if time.monotonic() >= expires_at:
+            del self._items[key]
+            return None
+        return value
+
+    def set(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
+        self._items[key] = (time.monotonic() + self._ttl, value)

+package com.example.app.cache
+
+import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
+
+class CacheManager(private val durationMillis: Long = 3600000L) {
+    
+    private data class CacheEntry(
+        val value: String,
+        val timestamp: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
+    )
+    
+    private val cache: MutableMap<String, CacheEntry> = ConcurrentHashMap()
+    
+    fun get(key: String): String? {
+        val entry = cache[key] ?: return null
+        val age = System.currentTimeMillis() - entry.timestamp
+        
+        return if (age < durationMillis) {
+            entry.value
+        } else {
+            cache.remove(key)
+            null
+        }
+    }
+    
+    fun put(key: String, value: String) {
+        cache[key] = CacheEntry(value, System.currentTimeMillis())
+    }
+    
+    fun remove(key: String) {
+        cache.remove(key)
+    }
+    
+    fun clear() {
+        cache.clear()
+    }
+    
+    fun exists(key: String): Boolean {
+        return cache.containsKey(key)
+    }
+}

+-- Add version column for optimistic locking on users table

+ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT check_version CHECK (version > 0);
+
+-- Update transaction isolation to repeatable read
+ALTER DATABASE application_db SET default_transaction_isolation = 'repeatable read';
+
+-- Replace update function with version checking

+    p_id INT,
+    p_version INT,
+    p_email VARCHAR

+BEGIN
+    UPDATE users SET version = version + 1, email = p_email
+    WHERE id = p_id AND version = p_version;

+import os

+
+class VaultCredentialManager:
+    def __init__(self, vault_address: str = None):
+        self.vault_address = vault_address or os.getenv('VAULT_ADDR')
+        self.client = hvac.Client(url=self.vault_address)
+        token = os.getenv('VAULT_TOKEN')
+        if not token:
+            raise RuntimeError('VAULT_TOKEN environment variable not set')
+        self.client.token = token
+    
+    def get_secret(self, secret_path: str, key: str = None):
+        response = self.client.secrets.kv.v2.read_secret_version(secret_path)
+        data = response['data']['data']
+        if key:
+            return data.get(key)
+        return data
+    
+    def list_secrets(self, path: str) -> list:
+        secrets = self.client.secrets.kv.v2.list_secrets(path)
+        return secrets['data']['keys']

+import boto3
+import hashlib
+from datetime import datetime
+
+def migrate():
+    """
+    Rewrite all user records to add email normalization and hash
+    """
+    dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
+    table = dynamodb.Table('users')
+    
+    response = table.scan()
+    items = response.get('Items', [])
+    
+    with table.batch_writer(overwrite_by_pkeys=['user_id']) as batch:
+        for item in items:
+            # Delete original item
+            batch.delete_item(Key={'user_id': item['user_id']})
+    
+    with table.batch_writer() as batch:
+        for item in items:
+            # Normalize email
+            if 'email' in item:
+                item['email'] = item['email'].lower().strip()
+                item['email_hash'] = hashlib.md5(
+                    item['email'].encode()
+                ).hexdigest()
+            
+            # Add migration timestamp
+            item['data_version'] = 2
+            item['migrated_at'] = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
+            
+            batch.put_item(Item=item)
+    
+    print(f"Migrated {len(items)} records")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    migrate()

+import torch
+import os
+import shutil
+from pathlib import Path
+
+def reset_model_cache():
+    cache_path = Path('./models/cache')
+    if cache_path.exists():
+        shutil.rmtree(cache_path)
+    
+    inference_cache = Path('./inference_cache')
+    if inference_cache.exists():
+        shutil.rmtree(inference_cache)
+    
+    embeddings_path = Path('./embeddings')
+    if embeddings_path.exists():
+        for f in embeddings_path.glob('*.npy'):
+            f.unlink()
+    
+    feature_store_path = Path('./features')
+    if feature_store_path.exists():
+        for f in feature_store_path.glob('*.pkl'):
+            f.unlink()
+
+def migrate_models():
+    reset_model_cache()
+    
+    model_dir = Path('./models/weights')
+    for model_file in model_dir.glob('*.pt'):
+        state = torch.load(model_file)
+        if 'legacy_embeddings' in state:
+            del state['legacy_embeddings']
+        torch.save(state, model_file)

+from django.db import migrations
+
+
+def migrate_permissions(apps, schema_editor):
+    User = apps.get_model('auth', 'User')
+    for user in User.objects.all():
+        if user.old_permissions_csv:
+            perms = [int(p) for p in user.old_permissions_csv.split(',')]
+            user.permissions = '|'.join(str(p) for p in perms)
+            user.old_permissions_csv = None
+            user.save()
+
+
+def reverse_migrate(apps, schema_editor):
+    User = apps.get_model('auth', 'User')
+    for user in User.objects.all():
+        if user.permissions:
+            perms = user.permissions.split('|')
+            user.old_permissions_csv = ','.join(perms)
+            user.permissions = None
+            user.save()
+
+
+class Migration(migrations.Migration):
+
+    dependencies = [
+        ('auth', '0044_add_permissions_field'),
+    ]
+
+    operations = [
+        migrations.RunPython(
+            migrate_permissions,
+            reverse_migrate,
+        ),
+    ]

+module Api
+  module V1
+    class ReportsController < ApplicationController
+      before_action :authenticate_user!
+      before_action :check_feature_enabled, only: [:create]
+
+      def create
+        report_type = params.require(:type)
+        unless %w[sales revenue inventory].include?(report_type)
+          return render json: { error: 'Invalid report type' }, status: :bad_request
+        end
+
+        report = Report.create(
+          user: current_user,
+          report_type: report_type,
+          start_date: params[:start_date],
+          end_date: params[:end_date]
+        )
+
+        ReportGeneratorJob.perform_later(report.id)
+        render json: { id: report.id, status: 'generating' }, status: :accepted
+      end
+
+      def show
+        report = Report.find(params[:id])
+        authorize_report(report)
+        render json: report
+      end
+
+      private
+
+      def check_feature_enabled
+        render json: { error: 'Reports unavailable' }, status: :service_unavailable unless Feature.enabled?(:advanced_reports)
+      end
+    end
+  end
+end

+import pytest
+from sqlalchemy import inspect, text
+from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
+from tests.db_fixtures import database
+
+
+def test_audit_table_created(database: Engine):
+    """Verify audit table exists after migration."""
+    inspector = inspect(database)
+    assert 'user_audit' in inspector.get_table_names()
+
+
+def test_audit_table_columns(database: Engine):
+    """Verify audit table has all required columns."""
+    inspector = inspect(database)
+    columns = {col.name for col in inspector.get_columns('user_audit')}
+    
+    required = {'id', 'user_id', 'action', 'timestamp', 'changes'}
+    assert required.issubset(columns)
+
+
+def test_audit_primary_key(database: Engine):
+    """Verify primary key constraint exists."""
+    inspector = inspect(database)
+    pk = inspector.get_pk_constraint('user_audit')
+    assert pk['constrained_columns'] == ['id']
+
+
+def test_audit_indexes(database: Engine):
+    """Verify performance indexes are created."""
+    inspector = inspect(database)
+    indexes = [idx.name for idx in inspector.get_indexes('user_audit')]
+    
+    assert 'idx_user_audit_user_id' in indexes
+    assert 'idx_user_audit_timestamp' in indexes
+
+
+def test_audit_trigger_fires(database: Engine):
+    """Verify trigger captures user updates."""
+    with database.connect() as conn:
+        conn.execute(text("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (999, 'Test')"))
+        conn.execute(text("UPDATE users SET name = 'Updated' WHERE id = 999"))
+        result = conn.execute(text("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_audit WHERE user_id = 999"))

+"""Archive and anonymize historical user data"""
+from alembic import op
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+
+revision = '006'
+down_revision = '005'
+branch_labels = None
+depends_on = None
+
+def upgrade():
+    # Purge request logs older than 18 months
+    op.execute("""
+        DELETE FROM request_logs
+        WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '18 months'
+    """)
+    
+    # Anonymize user PII in archived records
+    op.execute("""
+        UPDATE user_accounts
+        SET email = 'archived-' || md5(email::text),
+            phone = NULL,
+            full_name = 'User ' || id
+        WHERE archived_at IS NOT NULL
+    """)
+    
+    # Clear temporary session tokens
+    op.execute("""
+        DELETE FROM session_tokens
+        WHERE expires_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
+    """)
+    
+    # Truncate sensitive audit details
+    op.execute("""
+        UPDATE audit_trail SET request_body = NULL
+        WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months'
+    """)
+
+def downgrade():

+import anthropic
+from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
+from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
+
+def run_migration():
+    """Migrate message data using Claude for classification"""
+    client = anthropic.Anthropic()
+    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///app.db")
+    Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
+    session = Session()
+    
+    messages = session.execute(
+        text("SELECT id, content FROM messages WHERE classification IS NULL")
+    ).fetchall()
+    
+    for msg_id, content in messages:
+        try:
+            response = client.messages.create(
+                model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
+                max_tokens=50,
+                messages=[{
+                    "role": "user",
+                    "content": f"Classify this: {content}"
+                }]
+            )
+            classification = response.content[0].text.strip()
+            session.execute(
+                text("UPDATE messages SET classification = :cls WHERE id = :id"),
+                {"cls": classification, "id": msg_id}
+            )
+        except Exception as e:

+package com.example.aiagent.tools
+
+import android.content.ContentValues
+import android.provider.CalendarContract.Events
+import com.example.aiagent.Tool
+import java.time.Instant
+import java.time.ZoneId
+import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
+
+class ScheduleCalendarEventTool(private val calendarProvider: CalendarProvider) : Tool {
+    override val name = "schedule_calendar_event"
+    override val description = "Schedule an event in the device calendar"
+
+    override val parameters = mapOf(
+        "title" to "string",
+        "start_time_iso" to "string",
+        "end_time_iso" to "string",
+        "location" to "string"
+    )
+
+    override fun execute(params: Map<String, Any>): String {
+        val title = params["title"] as String
+        val startIso = params["start_time_iso"] as String
+        val endIso = params["end_time_iso"] as String
+        val location = params["location"] as? String ?: ""
+
+        val formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_INSTANT
+        val startMillis = Instant.from(formatter.parse(startIso)).toEpochMilli()
+        val endMillis = Instant.from(formatter.parse(endIso)).toEpochMilli()
+
+        val values = ContentValues().apply {
+            put(Events.TITLE, title)
+            put(Events.EVENT_LOCATION, location)
+            put(Events.DTSTART, startMillis)
+            put(Events.DTEND, endMillis)
+            put(Events.EVENT_TIMEZONE, ZoneId.systemDefault().id)
+        }
+        return "Scheduled: $title on $location"
+    }
+}

+WHERE user_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM users);
